dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge spline extending from the posterior base to the acute apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute, pointed geometry with minimal rounding radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, low-curvature convexity along the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick beak projection; length is approximately equal to its thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle (approximately 150 degrees) at the melon-rostrum junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Caudal fin (fluke) is visible, exhibiting sharp, geometric tip morphology and a distinct median notch.
